summary: Tested the Contabilità generale module end to end, both backend and frontend. Backend: new pytest suite test_iteration31_contabilita.py with 23 tests, all passing. It creates its own TEST_T31 company and cleans it up afterwards. Covered: seeding (205 accounts on 3 levels, 17 causali, 25 codici IVA, default parametri); CRUD of conti, causali and codici IVA with their validation rules; parametri validation; FV entry created when SDI returns consegnata (article contropartita and default contropartita, ritenuta); NV for TD04 with reversed sides; idempotency; FA on passive XML upload using the supplier's conto_costo; IN/PG/MB entries from bank reconciliation and their removal on annulla; deleting a passive invoice removes its entry; manual entries (balance check, sottoconti only, edit and delete; automatic entries cannot be edited or deleted); rigenera; libro giornale filters and totals; mastrino (prefix, saldo iniziale, party filter, 404); bilancio (dare = avere, risultato = ricavi - costi = attività - passività, 3 levels); 403 for all contabilita endpoints when the module is off. Frontend (Playwright on TEST_Coge Srl): sidebar groups correct and all old nav-* testids present; Prima nota dialog quadratura disables and enables the save button; create, edit, origine filter and rigenera toast work; automatic entries have no edit or delete buttons; mastrino and bilancio render correctly; piano-conti tabs work (add with parent check, rename, delete, search, causali and IVA create/delete, parametri save); article 'Contropartita di vendita' and supplier 'Contropartita di acquisto' selects present; switching the module off hides the nav group and redirects /contabilita/*; mobile menu works. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: All registra_* coroutines are created before any is awaited, and only ValueError is caught. Any other exception (for example KeyError on a malformed document) returns 500 and leaves the remaining coroutines un-awaited. Suggest building the coroutines lazily and catching Exception for each one.
The parties lookup filters only by id, without company_id. Low risk because ids are UUIDs, but it is not tenant-scoped.

conto_costo/conto_ricavo validation reads coa_accounts without calling ensure_seed. Through the API, if the company has never opened any contabilita page, a valid code is rejected with 400. The UI is not affected because ContoSelect loads /contabilita/conti first, which seeds.
Recreated entries take new numbers from the counter, so the libro giornale numbering gets gaps or goes out of date order. Accepted, but worth noting.

issues: The final balance cell ('1020,00 € D') wraps onto two lines. Add whitespace-nowrap to the tfoot saldo cell.
The ContoSelect controls for roles and categories are not disabled for read-only users. The save button is hidden, but the selects can still be changed.
Native browser date inputs are used instead of the shadcn calendar. This matches the rest of the app.

Optional: add whitespace-nowrap to the mastrino tfoot saldo cell; disable the parametri selects when !canEdit
critical_code_review_comments: Accounting maths checked. Sales: D clienti(netto) + D ritenute = A ricavi(+cassa) + A IVA(-split). Purchases: D costo(tot-iva) + D IVA(+rc) = A IVA vendite(rc) + A split + A fornitori(tot-rit-split) + A ritenute. Both balance.

On incasso reconciliation, if a credit note has reduced the invoice residual, the excess goes to the transitorio account 13.05.009. This is correct behaviour (verified: 305 → 244 clienti + 61 transitorio).
The unique index coge_ref_unique plus the _ready() check make automatic registration idempotent (verified).
In _push_status, registra_vendita is wrapped in coge.safe, so failures only produce a log warning and are never shown to the user. Consider surfacing them, for example as a badge on the invoice.
seed_data_creation: The pytest suite creates and deletes its own company TEST_T31 Coge <RUN> Srl plus its users and sessions. On TEST_Coge Srl (f3a3faa6-...) the UI tests created a manual entry, conto 30.07.077 and causale TUI; all were deleted. The module was switched off and back on, and parametri were re-saved with unchanged values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration31_contabilita.py -n 0. For UI auth: page.request.post /api/auth/login with the admin credentials, then localStorage fe_company_id=<cid>. Prima nota rigenera and deletes use window.confirm, so accept dialogs in Playwright. The system date is 2026-11-09.
